==Ingredients==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (240 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) grated [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|cheddar cheese]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* ¼ tsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] (500 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) mild or hot [[Cookbook:Sausage|sausage]]
* ¾ cup (180 ml) fine [[Cookbook:Cracker|cracker]] crumbs
* [[Cookbook:Vegetable Oil|Vegetable oil]]

==Procedure==

=== Method 1 ===
# Combine the cheese, flour, sausage and cracker crumbs.
# Using your hands, mix well and shape into 1-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (2.5 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) balls. 
# Put enough oil in a skillet to fill the skillet to a depth of about ¾ [[Cookbook:Inch|inches]] (2 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]). 
# Heat the oil. When it is hot, place the balls in the pan without crowding them.
# Cook over medium-high heat, turning until all sides are golden brown.
# Drain on [[Cookbook:Paper Towel|paper towels]].

=== Method 2 ===
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 375°F (230°C). 
# Mix all ingredients together thoroughly
# Form into 1-inch (2.5 cm) balls, and place on ungreased [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|cookie sheets]]. 
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 15 minutes or until golden brown. 

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Sausage cheese balls can be frozen uncooked. Thaw and cook according to directions.
